title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on Joshua 16: the lot of the children of Joseph and the borders of Ephraim's inheritance.

questions.text: For whom did the lot come out in this chapter, starting from the Jordan at Jericho?
questions.explanation: The lot came out for the children of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east.

questions.text: Going up from Jericho through the hill country, the border reached which city?
questions.explanation: The border went up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel.

questions.text: From Bethel the border went out to which place?
questions.explanation: It went out from Bethel to Luz, and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth.

questions.text: Going down westward past Beth Horon the lower, the border went on to which city?
questions.explanation: The border went down westward to Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer, and ended at the sea.

questions.text: Which two took their inheritance as the children of Joseph?
questions.explanation: The children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

questions.text: Ephraim's eastern border ran from Ataroth Addar to which place?
questions.explanation: The border of Ephraim's inheritance eastward was Ataroth Addar, to Beth Horon the upper.

questions.text: To which place did the border turn eastward from Michmethath?
questions.explanation: The border turned about eastward to Taanath Shiloh and passed along it on the east of Janoah.

questions.text: From Tappuah, the border went westward to which brook?
questions.explanation: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah, and ended at the sea.

questions.text: Where were some cities set apart for the children of Ephraim?
questions.explanation: Cities were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh.

answers.text: In the middle of Manasseh's inheritance
In the middle of Judah's inheritance
In the land of the Philistines

questions.text: What happened to the Canaanites who lived in Gezer?
questions.explanation: Ephraim did not drive them out; the Canaanites dwell in Ephraim's territory and have become servants doing forced labor.

answers.text: They were all driven out of Gezer
They fled from Gezer to Egypt
They stayed and were put to forced labor
